For n≤10 all factors occur in one of the four μ^m(ab), 2^m≥n, which gives a genuinely complete finite class. Direct independent factor generation and grouping matched all ten maximum fibers and higher lengths through n=17. At n=10 each factor contains ≥4 ones. For n≥10 the exact two-tortoise formula determined by the first three ones and the unchanged later suffix injects a fiber into its first-ten-symbol fiber, giving ≤2. Campbell–Rampersad Theorem 6 yields noninjectivity of the single-tortoise image at every n≥10, hence T² is noninjective and ≥2. No finite-length extrapolation substitutes for the injection/lower argument.
